dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge, appearing as solid white-grey spots with minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle; a secondary group of smaller annuli creates a roughly linear alignment along the lateral mid-line.
